scope: Current local prototype at the existing browser viewport; winter, manual summer switch and lotus via timeline. No code changes.
verdict: Usable as an interactive prototype and technical sample; polished original visual reproduction remains incomplete.

steps.strength: Clear winter/night identity and layered foreground.
steps.issue: Pines repeat regular horizontal branching; season controls are faint and small.

steps.strength: Manual season switch works; central sunset reflection establishes the focal point.
steps.issue: Dense uniform grasses and repeated luminous flowers reduce natural depth.

steps.strength: Timeline navigation works; pale paper, vertical type and mist share a consistent atmosphere.
steps.issue: Mist suppresses petal contrast; flower and butterfly remain visibly procedural.

limits: No current-run cross-device, FPS, memory or accessibility compliance measurement.
Original source code unavailable; no complete feature parity claim.
technicalObservations: Unified timeline, scene scheduling, compositing and audio provide reusable modules.
Scene parameters and numeric branch logic remain hardcoded; no general visual editor.
